overlooked_assumption: The agent assumed that provider_config.canonical_model() would always succeed for any valid model/provider combination, but it raises ValueError when the model is not recognized as a decisions model by that provider's config, and the exception was not caught at the right level for the guardrail settings request path.
why_it_breaks: The GET /guardrails/ui/add_guardrail_settings endpoint calls prepare_call() which invokes provider_config.canonical_model(upstream_model). When a model that is not a recognized decisions model (e.g., a default model or a model without a decisions config) is passed, canonical_model() raises a ValueError. The try/except on line 176-179 catches this and raises BadRequestError, but the guardrail settings endpoint does not handle this exception properly, resulting in an ImportError/500 being returned to the UI, which shows an empty provider list because the request fails before providers can be listed.
